title: MERGE-XAI-SYNC C-02 SHAPE ARM — zero-step mechanism case pinning the TRUNCATED-STREAM capture shape (the MW-3 'without done' condition, wire-side): pre-placed wire inputs (cases/mxai-c02-trunc-shape/wire/, symlinked into the redteam case-stem dir; copy-if-absent into the run dir) = one redacted structural /v1/messages request (req-001.json) + a truncated SSE response capture (resp-001.jsonl: 200 text/event-stream; message_start → content_block_start → three content_block_delta frames — then the stream ENDS: no message_stop, no [DONE], no frame past the last delta). The kind=resp_stream pin runs in mode=exact (1:1 length + per-frame canonical match, volatile ids nulled via normalize) against the pinned truncated fixture: the actual post-drop frame sequence must be EXACTLY the truncated shape — nothing after the last delta. A frame past the last delta (message_stop, [DONE], or any extra delta) = the stream was NOT truncated (the shape premise failed) or the capture is contaminated = STOP. This arm is the executable half of C-02 while the live fault-injection arm is a DRIVER GAP (MXAI-C02 disabled; see smoke/merge-xai/README.md): it (a) verifies the runner's SSE frame parser against the documented truncated shape now, and (b) becomes the LIVE shape pin once injection exists — run the live case with the same where-scope and the live wiretap capture OVERWRITES the pre-placed file (open('w') semantics: the live capture is the evidence), so this exact fixture scores the real truncated stream. Runs in proxy:none L1 key-free mode (no proxy key, no live calls). VERDICT: PASS = exact 1:1 truncated-frame identity; FAIL with first-unmatched-frame named = the stream was complete or contaminated.

wire.label: TRUNCATED-STREAM SHAPE PIN (the MW-3 condition, wire-side): the actual post-drop SSE frame sequence must be EXACTLY the pinned truncated shape — 1:1 (mode=exact): message_start, content_block_start, three content_block_delta, and NOTHING after the last delta (no message_stop, no [DONE], no extra frames; keepalive comment frames are skipped by the parser, documented). The count band 5..5 re-states the ceiling: a sixth frame = the stream completed or the capture is contaminated = STOP. Volatile per-run ids/usage/delta-text are nulled via the normalize list (FRAME-DATA-ROOT-RELATIVE — the engine applies them per frame data object; in-tree precedent resp-stream-smoke-01; wave-2 authoring correction: the originally authored 'data.'-prefixed paths were no-ops on the flat /v1/messages frame shape, and 'delta.text' was added so the LIVE truncated stream (which overwrites this scaffold capture) scores on shape, not on the redacted text); frame ORDER is significant (list order is never normalized).

SCOPE BOUND (B-i companion): the where-filter matches exactly ONE capture in this case's wire dir — the resp_stream's which:last selection is unambiguous because N is bounded here (the pre-placed single request).
